name: Capterra Scraper
description: Capterra scraper for Python and the command line: the software products of a Capterra category with vendor, star rating, rating breakdown, sub-scores, review counts, starting price, free trial and paid-placement flag, as JSON or CSV. Free and open source; sign in with your QuanticData account, no proxies or headless browser to run.

commands.name: products
commands.help: software products listed in a Capterra category
commands.description: Software products from a Capterra category: vendor, rating, rating breakdown, sub-scores, pricing and paid-placement flag.

inputs.name: category
inputs.description: Software category as a plain keyword ("crm", "project management", "help desk", "accounting"), matched against Capterra's own category index, where an exact name wins ("crm" is CRM, not Construction CRM). A Capterra category slug or URL works too.

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: Country to run the request from, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (us, gb, de...).

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many products to deliver at most (1–500). You pay only for delivered products.
